remarks: Charming 1,080 sq ft bungalow w/ double attached garage, 9' main flr ceilings, 9' bsmt ceilings & LVP flooring thru main. A welcoming foyer offers garage access and a convenient 2-piece bath, opening to a bright great room w/ FP, dining nook & kitchen. Thoughtful layout places 2nd bedroom, basement stairs, and laundry on opposite side for privacy. Laundry connects to Walk-in closet, which leads to 4-pc ensuite and primary bedroom, also accessible from kitchen for added convenience. Primary retreat features dbl sinks and stand-up shower w/ glass doors. Kitchen blends style & function w/ peninsula including flush eating ledge & pendant lighting, built-in microwave, chimney-style hood fan, Silgranit undermount sink overlooking backyard, quartz counters, upgraded raised-profile cabinets, full-height tile backsplash & generous pantry. Garden door off the kitchen provides access to the backyard deck for outdoor enjoyment. Black plumbing/lighting fixtures & basement rough-in pkg included. (id:67522)
features: Microwave, Hood Fan, Garage door opener, Garage door opener remote(s)
